title: Union with Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Union with Christ means that believers are joined to Jesus by faith through the Spirit and share in His death, resurrection, righteousness, life, and hope. Every saving blessing is received in Him.
summary: Union with Christ means that believers are joined to Jesus by faith through the Spirit and share in His death, resurrection, righteousness, life, and hope. Every saving blessing is received in Him.
christFocus: Jesus is not merely a Savior outside His people; He joins believers to Himself. In Him, they die to sin, live to God, receive grace, and await glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Union with Christ is central to salvation. Believers are not merely given religious benefits; they are joined to the living Christ and receive every spiritual blessing in Him.

This union means believers share in Christ’s death and resurrection. They have died with Him to sin’s old mastery and are raised with Him to walk in newness of life.

Union with Christ also means dependence. Jesus is the vine and His people are branches. Apart from Him they can do nothing, but abiding in Him bears fruit.

This doctrine gathers many saving blessings together. Justification, adoption, sanctification, perseverance, resurrection, and glory come to believers because they belong to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers think of salvation as only a legal status or a past decision. Union with Christ shows that salvation is living participation in the crucified and risen Savior.

This doctrine gives identity to those who feel defined by shame, failure, disability, addiction, rejection, or suffering. The deepest truth about a believer is that they are in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live from your union with Christ. Do not define yourself by old sin, shame, or weakness. Abide in Him, depend on Him, put sin to death, and walk as one whose life is hidden with Christ in God.
